chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Whoever performs four rakʿahs during travel, then I am disassociated from him before Allah."

key_terms.أَرْبَعًا: four rakʿahs; the full form of certain prayers
key_terms.بَرِيءٌ: disassociated; a strong expression of repudiation
key_terms.ٱلسَّفَرِ: travel; the state in which specific prayer rulings apply

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on praying four rakʿahs during travel in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith states a severe warning regarding performing the prayer in full during travel when the ruling is to shorten it. The final phrase clarifies that this warning applies to one who does so intentionally.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
The Messenger of Allah (sw) said:
"Whoever performs four units of prayer during travel, I disassociate myself from him in front of Allah (swt)”.
